---
name: Feature request
about: A job a kit should do, or a kit the collection is missing
title: "[KitOrNew] Short summary"
labels: enhancement
---

**The job**
What are you trying to do, in plain words? WinDevKit grows from
named friction — every resource here maps to a real pain point in
`docs/PAIN_POINTS.md` — so the situation matters more than the
proposed API.

**Where it bites today**
What you do instead right now, and what that costs (boilerplate,
a hand-rolled helper per app, an external dependency, ...).

**Which kit should grow, or is this a new kit?**
If new: the one job it would do, and why no existing kit covers it.
The collection's shape is one small DLL per job, plain C ABI, JSON
in and out, no Rust crate dependencies.

**Anything else?**
Links to how other libraries solve it are welcome.
